hero.label: Full-Stack AI Engineer · Tashkent
hero.tagline: I build AI products from interface to infrastructure. Go, TypeScript and Vue/Nuxt — with hands-on work on voice pipelines, tool-using assistants and evaluations.

about.label: 01 / About
about.line1: AI products, built end to end.
about.line2: Since November 2023, I have built fintech interfaces with complex business logic: an SME financing frontend from scratch, digital-signature integrations, performance improvements and an internal MCP server for AI development tools.
about.line3: I also created Hamyonimda from scratch: a personal finance product with a Go backend, Vue/Nuxt interfaces, voice and SMS intake, payments and deployment infrastructure. My AI work includes model comparisons, failure recovery and multilingual evaluations.

services.label: 02 / Expertise
services.title: From useful interfaces to AI systems.

items.title: Product interfaces
items.body: Vue and Nuxt applications with complex state, financial workflows and attention to performance and accessibility.

items.title: Backend & data
items.body: Go APIs, PostgreSQL, asynchronous workers, payment integrations and transactional financial logic.

items.title: Applied AI
items.body: Speech-to-text, structured extraction, tool-using assistants and MCP. Model choices tested against correctness, latency and cost.

items.title: Delivery & operations
items.body: Docker deployments, CI/CD, monitoring and recovery from production failures. Ownership continues after launch.

projects.hamyonimda: Voice, bank SMS and text become financial records across a Telegram bot, Mini App and web dashboard, with payments and multilingual interfaces.
projects.skale: Conversion-focused site for a Tashkent marketing agency: 3D dispersed glass hero, scroll choreography, static export.
projects.fides: Medical tourism platform for Uzbekistan: clinics, doctors, transparent pricing, end-to-end support.

caseStudy.intro: Personal finance that starts with your voice.
caseStudy.ownership: I designed and built the frontend, backend, AI integrations and deployment infrastructure. One product, from the Telegram experience to the database and production operations.
caseStudy.productBody: Voice, bank SMS and text become financial records across a Telegram bot, Mini App and web dashboard, with payments and multilingual interfaces.
caseStudy.aiBody: Language-aware retries and provider fallback for voice intake. Hami development adds tool calling, calculations in Go and checks against tool results, supported by multilingual evaluations.
caseStudy.evaluation: Correct amount extractions before and after pipeline/model changes on a 38-example evaluation set (66% → 92%). A scoped experiment, not a production-wide accuracy claim.
